decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already limits eligible winners to Small Block ticket holders; the selection method, VRF provider, fairness, and verification method remain valid.
Eliminating Big Block does not change the existing Small Block winner count, $500 prize amount, eligible population, or 100-sale trigger.
The existing same-message MODIFY already changes the no-code ticket award to a Small Block prize ticket; its trigger, recipient eligibility, and $5 commission remain unchanged.
The existing same-message MODIFY already removes Big Block references from the affected FAQ descriptions and records the new $5/$5/$5 primary-mint split.
The existing same-message MODIFY already identifies the Small Block pool as the sole active prize pool and sets its primary-mint allocation to $5; the remaining funding rules are unaffected.
The existing same-message MODIFY already removes the obsolete big_block_ticket_counter_visible key while preserving the Small Block counter and unrelated metadata.
The existing same-message MODIFY already changes each successful coded referral's ticket award from Small and Big Block tickets to one Small Block ticket.
Removing Big Block does not change the generic automatic prize-transfer workflow, Winners page announcement, or winner-notification channels.
The source changes Big Block mechanics and the primary-mint allocation but does not change the required flat $10 secondary-sale royalty.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records the $15 mint split as $5 founder, $5 affiliate, and $5 for the Small Block prize pool, including cleanup of the superseded broad funding key.
The certificate and confirmation-email requirement contains no Big Block-specific content or behavior that must change because of the source decision.
The Big Block removal and revenue reallocation do not change the deferred Transak provider, payment methods, wallet provisioning, or fiat mint-delivery flow.
